name: dariokart
description: Dariokart — a Super Mario Kart–inspired kart racer for the web, rendered with Rive: a GPU 3D world written with Rive Scripting (Luau + WGSL), AnimaScript speed effects, Rive artboards and UI, bots at three difficulty levels, procedural chiptune audio and Firebase online multiplayer.
author: Pedro Massango

scripts.build: npm run riv && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.rive:publish: rive rive/world3d --publish && rive rive/speedfx --publish && cp rive/world3d/build/world3d.riv rive/speedfx/build/speedfx.riv public/assets/
